title: Ministry of Cooperation 5th Foundation Day: Plans Cooperative Life Insurance & 'Sahakar Taxi'
summary: Announces utility aggregator cooperative for ride-hailing and converts 50,000 PACS into e-PACS.

blocks.content: Announces utility aggregator cooperative for ride-hailing and converts 50,000 PACS into e-PACS.

items: Cooperative Life Insurance: Plans dedicated cooperative life insurer building on IFFCO-Tokio general insurance model.
Sahakar Taxi Aggregator: Establishes utility aggregator cooperative on lines of 'Bharat Taxi' (0.63M drivers, 3.58M registered users).
Infrastructure & Seeds: Transferred 135 godowns (75,000 tonnes capacity) and signed BBSSL-ICAR MoU for certified seed tissue culture.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Ministry of Cooperation formed July 6, 2021 | Minister: Amit Shah.
